a, b, n = map(int, input().split())

def abs_val(a):
    return -a if a < 0 else a

min_diff = 1e100
res_x, res_y = 0, 0

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    x = i
    y1 = int((a / b) * i)
    y0 = y1 + 1
    diff1 = abs_val((a / b) - (y1 / x))
    diff2 = abs_val((a / b) - (y0 / x))
    if min_diff > diff1:
        min_diff = diff1
        res_x = y1
        res_y = x
    if min_diff > diff2:
        min_diff = diff2
        res_x = y0
        res_y = x

print(f"{res_x}/{res_y}")
